quote.text: How often should I really change the oil if I tow or drive short trips

lines.text: Typical intervals by mileage to compare with your owner's manual, how to read its normal and severe columns, and how to write yours down once.

head.text: Oil and filter, tire rotation, a look at tread and pressure.
Brake inspection, cabin and engine air filters (often at 12,000 to 15,000 miles), battery test.
Brake fluid and fuel filter, if your car has one to change.
Coolant, transmission fluid and spark plugs.
Timing belt, on engines that have a belt rather than a chain.

line.text: Enter the interval you actually believe, then turn on severe duty for that one job to halve it. Nothing here overrides your number with its own.
